APPROVE

The extraction moves the whole nested foreach/try-catch/foreach/if block, with its `CHA0004` pragma scope intact, into a private static helper that returns the same dictionary. That removes roughly 9 points of nested complexity from `CollectAsync`, so it should land well under 15, and the behaviour is identical. I could not check that `lockfiles` is a `List<string>` at the call site, since the repo isn't available here, but the diff gives no sign of a mismatch.
